headline: 464 weapons seized: Three held with 464 weapons at Baitul Mukarram
summary: Police have arrested three individuals in connection with the possession of a large cache of weapons at the Baitul Mukarram area.
details: Police have arrested three people after recovering 464 weapons from the Baitul Mukarram area in Dhaka.
The seizure took place during a drive conducted by law enforcement agencies to curb illegal weapon possession.
The recovered items include a wide variety of knives and sharp-edged weapons, as seen in the evidence displayed by the police.
The three suspects have been detained and are currently under investigation to determine the source and intended use of the weapons.

headline_marked: 1,085 new cases as [[2 die of suspected measles]] in 24 hours
headline: 1,085 new cases as 2 die of suspected measles in 24 hours
summary: Health officials report a surge in infections across the country, with over 16,000 confirmed cases since mid-March.
details: According to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) control room on Friday, two people died of suspected measles in the last 24 hours.
During the same period, 1,085 new measles infections were identified across the country.
The DGHS reported that 900 people were suspected of having measles in the last 24 hours, with 185 cases being confirmed.
Since March 15, the total number of suspected measles cases has reached 128,310, while confirmed cases stand at 16,059.
Between March 15 and July 31, approximately 110,987 people were admitted to hospitals for suspected measles.
Of those admitted, 106,859 patients have recovered and been discharged from the hospital.
caption:
Two deaths and over 1,000 new infections in just 24 hours. Measles is spreading rapidly across Bangladesh.

According to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) control room on Friday, two people died of suspected measles in the last 24 hours.

During the same period, 1,085 new measles infections were identified across the country.

The DGHS reported that 900 people were suspected of having measles in the last 24 hours, with 185 cases being confirmed.

Since March 15, the total number of suspected measles cases has reached 128,310, while confirmed cases stand at 16,059.

Between March 15 and July 31, approximately 110,987 people were admitted to hospitals for suspected measles.

Of those admitted, 106,859 patients have recovered and been discharged from the hospital.
